title: Self-Signaling and Prosocial Behavior: A Cause Marketing Experiment
authors: Jean‐Pierre Dubé; Xueming Luo; Zheng Fang
eligible_reason: Randomized field experiments (price x donation cells); demand estimated with probit / random-coefficient signaling probit by MLE. No staggered adoption, no DiD.
design_notes: main.m loads data.mat (Ydata, Xdata, Groupdata) and estimates probit, RC probit and signaling RC probit via Knitro (runprobit.m, runMLE_FM.m).
data_files_note: Experimental choice data at cell level shipped as data.mat.mat.
data_provenance_note: Experimental data as used in estimation.
screener_notes: No article text or PDF available locally (data/text and papers/ checked Nov 2); OpenAlex abstract from data/frame/mksc.jsonl read. Design read from the README and the main-results code; no package code was run.
